digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport pagination (_paged_search pager)
propositions: The _paged_search pager loops indefinitely when a server ignores or repeats startAt offsets, re-serving the same non-empty page without advancing, because the only loop exit is an empty batch check that never triggers.
When _paged_search spins on an offset-blind server, the resulting exception is silently swallowed by get_parent_map's broad exception handler, converting a loud signal into a silent empty parent map.

The same pagination stall exception is swallowed at three fetch_snapshot enrichment handler boundaries (parent, comment, issuelink), allowing the pass to write a degraded snapshot instead of failing loudly.
A startAt-ignoring stub server causes _paged_search to make 26 calls (measured at harness cap) instead of self-terminating within 2 calls, proving the absence of an offset-stall guard.
